summary: The layout struggles on a 320px viewport due to an uncollapsed sidebar creating severe horizontal compression across navigation labels and main content.

issues.title: Sidebar uncollapsed on narrow viewport
issues.description: Sidebar renders side-by-side instead of collapsing into a mobile drawer, causing aggressive truncation of navigation labels.
issues.evidence: Sidebar items ('Bridge call...', '14:02 · Dete...') and header text ('Evidence lo...') truncate after few characters.
issues.suggestion: Collapse sidebar into an overlay drawer or sheet below standard mobile breakpoints.

issues.title: Premature title truncation
issues.description: Heading text truncates with hyphenation rather than wrapping to an additional line.
issues.evidence: Title reads 'Checkout latency spike during flash-...' despite vertical space available for another line.
issues.suggestion: Allow title text to wrap to multiple lines before applying truncation.
